newsitem.title: UK: Megalomedia buys UK special effects firm.
newsitem.headline: Megalomedia buys UK special effects firm.

text.p: Britain's Megalomedia Plc said on Monday it bought Computer Film Holdings Ltd, which created special effects for movies like "Con Air" and "The Nutty Professor", for up to 8.6 million stg.
The holding company bought Computer Film for an initial payment of up to 5.1 million stg, comprising 2.46 million stg, plus 2.9 million new Megalomedia shares.
Computer Film is the holding company of Computer Film Co Ltd, which has operations in London and Hollywood and has worked on some 90 films in the U.S. and Europe.
Megalomedia also reported pretax profits of 1.66 million stg for the year to March 31, up from 309,000 stg in the previous year.
The firm paid an initial dividend of 0.2p per share.
Chairman Lord Saatchi said the acquisition was part of Megalomedia's plan to rank as one of Britain's leading media and new media companies.
Megalomedia's shares were marked up 2.5p at 95 by 0740 GMT.
